coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Using the nine ground-truth variable categories, five match: weight precisions, quantization methods, WikiText-2 evaluation at sequence length 2048, perplexity, and Inf/NaN stability detection. This gives 5/9, rounded to 56%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The scheme is explicitly symmetric rather than asymmetric. Weight-only quantization permits FP16/BF16 activations and does not explicitly fix KV caches to FP16. The baseline likewise permits BF16 instead of fixing A16W16. Model selection includes LLaMA-3 rather than exclusively LLAMA2-7B, LLAMA2-13B, and LLAMA2-70B. Additional datasets and metrics expand the scope beyond the specified experiment.

coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the table results, QuaRot-GPTQ improvements at low precision, persistent RTN failures, partial QuaRot-RTN stabilization, or the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
